summary: Backend tested via 16 pytest cases against external EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 16 passed (100%) including JWT auth, full CRUD for products/warehouses/categories/suppliers, stock movements (receive/remove/adjust with clamp-at-zero), Open Food Facts barcode lookup (known + unknown), dashboard aggregations, rule-based reorder suggestions, PO email draft, AI insights (Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY returned a non-empty insight), and multi-tenant data isolation between two users.

minor.issue: Always returns 200 {ok:true} even when the resource does not exist or belongs to another owner. Functionally safe (filtered by owner_id, no data leak) but not idempotency-friendly and hides 404. Consider returning 404 when matched_count==0.
Returns 404 when not found — fine; just note frontend must handle 404 gracefully when scanning a new barcode for the first time.
passlib emits a benign warning: 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__'. Hash/verify still works. Pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib to silence.

action_items: Optional: return 404 on DELETE when no document matched the (id, owner_id) query for stronger REST semantics.
Optional: pin bcrypt to <4 in requirements.txt to remove the passlib startup warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 480-line file. Still manageable but consider splitting into routers/models/services if it grows further.
clean() pops _id and owner_id from documents consistently — good. No ObjectId leakage observed.
Movement endpoint correctly clamps quantity to 0 on over-removal and updates best_before_date when provided on a receive.
AI insights endpoint gracefully degrades to a friendly message on LLM failure (verified path works with real key).
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read via os.environ.get — acceptable; JWT_SECRET/MONGO_URL via os.environ[..] which fails fast if missing — good.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed products/suppliers/categories and delete them at end of each test. A second isolation user TEST_iso_<uuid>@test.com is registered per session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Existing tests at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py cover all endpoints listed in the review. Test user: warehouse@test.com / test123. AI endpoint takes ~5-15s — use timeout>=30s.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA. All review-listed endpoints verified end-to-end including Claude AI insights and per-user owner_id scoping (user B cannot read, find-by-barcode, move stock on, or affect user A's product).
